mcq: Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a medium that could be used for a number of purposes."
Video is a medium that could be used for a number of purposes.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is defined as that involvement which is provided by law, custom, or mutual agreement and for which a formal structure is provided."
Formal participation is defined as that involvement which is provided by law, custom, or mutual agreement and for which a formal structure is provided.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the first window to a people's culture."
Language is the first window to a people's culture.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the relative distribution of decision making among the groups of people in a school district."
Power structure is the relative distribution of decision making among the groups of people in a school district.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is derived from the Participatory Rural Communication Appraisal (PRCA) methodology created in the late 1990s."
The name Participatory Communication Assessment (PCA) is derived from the Participatory Rural Communication Appraisal (PRCA) methodology created in the late 1990s.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the conscious determination of courses of action designed to accomplish purposes."
Planning is the conscious determination of courses of action designed to accomplish purposes.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are used extensively where one wants to draw the attention of people to specific issues."
Posters and photos are used extensively where one wants to draw the attention of people to specific issues.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the accumulation of all available information and knowledge related to the issues."
Important to wise decision is the accumulation of all available information and knowledge related to the issues.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a consciousness of power relations contained in any human relationship."
Central to dialogic communication is a consciousness of power relations contained in any human relationship.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a veritable instrument of communication and they are of different types."
The media is a veritable instrument of communication and they are of different types.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a concern for how the chosen media and communication formats are used."
Linked to this choice is a concern for how the chosen media and communication formats are used.
